name: Apple M5 (MacBook Air / MacBook Pro 14-inch, 2026)
memory_bandwidth_basis: Apple tech specs: '153GB/s memory bandwidth' for the M5 chip with 10-core CPU / 8-core GPU or 10-core CPU / 10-core GPU. Unified-memory bandwidth, package-level, shared with the CPU.
notes: M5: 8-core or 10-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine, up to 32GB unified memory. The 153GB/s bandwidth is identical to the M3 Pro despite the newer generation - Apple kept the base chip bandwidth flat. For local LLM inference, 32GB unified memory is the practical minimum for comfortable 13B inference at 4-bit. The M5 is the entry-level Apple Silicon chip for local inference, found in MacBook Air and base MacBook Pro.
